Because this is a controller spec calling the action directly (not an integration/routing spec), it does not exercise the actual DELETE route/verb mapping added in `routes.rb`, so it can pass even if the real DELETE route is miswired. This is a coverage gap/test mismatch rather than a production defect in the diff.
